raw.title: v0.1.3
raw.body:
### Bug Fixes

- **Single-step execution now honors control flow actions.** `--step` mode previously ignored `onSuccess`/`onFailure` routing — retries didn't fire, `goto` targets were skipped, and `onSuccess: end` didn't stop execution. The step runner now processes all flow decisions (retry, goto, end, goto-workflow) consistently with full workflow execution.

- **Parallel execution routes errors through action handlers.** Runtime errors during parallel steps were immediately fatal instead of flowing through `onFailure` handlers. Trace records now reflect actual action decisions instead of hardcoded paths.

### Docs

- Added asciinema demo recording to README
- Added code of conduct, security policy, and issue templates

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strefethen/arazzo-cli/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
